title: The crosswalk from DHMİ's airport names to ICAO codes
description: DHMİ publishes traffic against a name and no code; OurAirports publishes everything else against the ICAO code. This is the one join that has to be made by hand, so it is written down and checked.

icao.description: The ICAO code, which OurAirports keys on. Every Turkish one begins LT.

dhmi.description: Every name DHMİ has printed for this airport, renames and respellings included.
